## Change and affected surfaces

Describe the request and authoritative data. List affected pages, product/pack sizes, checkout, admin, metadata, reports or runtime settings. Mark unrelated surfaces not applicable with a reason.

## Verification

- [ ] Shared main inspected; collaborator edits preserved.
- [ ] `npm run check:release` and applicable production/Worker checks passed.
- [ ] Prices, stock, code attribution, assets and metadata agree across affected consumers.
- [ ] Deployment and read-only live checks recorded for the tested commit, or explicitly pending.
- [ ] Dated release record lists files, URLs, evidence and remaining gaps without customer data or secrets.

Follow [the website change rule](https://github.com/thetaxfirm/biomodpeptides/blob/main/docs/website-change-rule-v1.md). A source check is not proof of live behavior.
